tasks.title: Grammar
tasks.instructions: Read the following sentences. Choose the correct answer for each gap. /12 x 1 = 12 points/

questions.stem: There's ___ old castle on ___ hill above the town.
questions.explanation: “old” эгшиг авиагаар эхэлж, цайз анх дурдагдаж байгаа тул “an old castle”; хотын дээрх тодорхой толгодыг заахдаа “the hill” гэж хэлдэг тул “an / the”.

questions.stem: My grandparents live ___ a small village ___ the north of Mongolia.
questions.explanation: Хот, тосгон дотор амьдрахад “in” (“in a small village”), орны хойд, өмнөд хэсгийг заахад мөн “in the north” гэж хэрэглэдэг тул “in / in”.

questions.stem: Please speak more ___. The baby is sleeping.
questions.explanation: “speak” үйл үгийг тодотгох тул дайвар үг хэрэгтэй; нялх хүүхэд унтаж байгаа (“The baby is sleeping”) тул “quietly” (чимээгүйхэн), харин “loudly” нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: There ___ no buses after midnight, so it ___ difficult to get home.
questions.explanation: “no buses” олон тоо тул “There are”, харин “it” ганц тоо тул “is difficult” болох бөгөөд “are / is” гэж нөхнө.

questions.stem: I ___ three cups of coffee today, and it's only 10 a.m.!
questions.explanation: “today” (өнөөдөр) хараахан дуусаагүй хугацаа тул өнөөдрийн дотор хийсэн үйлийг одоо төгссөн цаг “have drunk” илэрхийлнэ; “it's only 10 a.m.” гэсэн нь өдөр үргэлжилж байгааг харуулна.

questions.stem: The children ___ in the garden when it ___ to rain.
questions.explanation: Хүүхдүүд цэцэрлэгт тоглож байсан нь үргэлжилж байсан үйл (“were playing”), бороо орж эхэлсэн нь түүнийг тасалсан нэг удаагийн үйл (“started”) юм; “when” нь гэнэтийн үйлийг өнгөрсөн энгийн цагаар оруулна.

questions.stem: She can swim, ___?
questions.explanation: Эерэг өгүүлбэрт модаль үйл үг “can” байгаа тул хавсралт асуулт үгүйсгэлтэй, ижил модаль үйл үгээр бүтнэ: “She can swim, can't she?”

questions.stem: Don't phone me tomorrow between seven and nine. We ___ dinner with my parents' friends.
questions.explanation: “tomorrow between seven and nine” нь ирээдүйн тодорхой хугацаанд үргэлжилж байх үйлийг заах тул ирээдүйн үргэлжилсэн цаг “will be having” (оройн хоол идэж байх болно).

questions.stem: If we ___ a garden, we ___ our own vegetables.
questions.explanation: Одоо цэцэрлэггүй байгаа бодит бус байдлыг төсөөлж байгаа тул “If” хэсэг өнгөрсөн цагийн хэлбэр “had” авч, үр дүн нь “would grow” (өөрсдөө ногоо тарих байсан) болно.

questions.stem:
Customer: Where ___ these shoes made?
Assistant: They ___ in Italy.
questions.explanation: Гутлыг үйлдвэрт хийсэн, гутал өөрөө үйлдэгч биш тул асуулт, хариулт хоёуланд олон тооны (“these shoes”, “They”) үйлдэгдэх хэв орно: “Where were … made?”, “They were made in Italy”.

questions.stem: Our neighbours have a ___ cat.
questions.explanation: Тэмдэг нэрийн дараалал: үнэлгээ (“lovely”) → хэмжээ (“little”) → өнгө (“white”) → гарал үүсэл (“Persian”); тиймээс “lovely, little, white, Persian”.

questions.stem: We couldn't go out ___ the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: “the heavy rain” нь үйл үггүй нэр үгийн хэллэг; түүний өмнө шалтгааны угтвар хэллэг “because of” (…-ын улмаас) ордог бол “because” гэдгийн дараа заавал бүтэн өгүүлбэр байна.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the correct word for each blank. /10 x 2 = 20 points/

questions.stem: My uncle gets angry very quickly. He is quite ___.
questions.explanation: “gets angry very quickly” (амархан уурладаг) хүнийг “bad-tempered” (ааш муутай, уур уцаартай) гэнэ; “calm”, “patient” нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: Vitamins are ___ for healthy growth.
questions.explanation: “for healthy growth” (эрүүл өсөлтөд) гэсэн утгад “necessary” (зайлшгүй шаардлагатай) тохирно; “nervous” (сандарсан), “narrow” (нарийн) зэрэг үг утга зохицохгүй.

questions.stem: It is ___ to park here. You'll get a fine.
questions.explanation: “You'll get a fine” (торгууль ногдуулна) гэсэн нь энд машин тавих нь хууль бус буюу “illegal” болохыг харуулна; “illegible” нь уншигдахгүй гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: Walking 10,000 steps a day is good for your ___ health.
questions.explanation: “Walking 10,000 steps a day” нь биеийн хөдөлгөөн тул бие махбодын буюу “physical” эрүүл мэндэд тустай; “musical”, “political” зэрэг нь “health” гэдэгтэй зохицохгүй.

questions.stem: The nurse gave me an ___ to protect me from the flu.
questions.explanation: Томуунаас хамгаалахын тулд (“to protect me from the flu”) сувилагч тарилга буюу “injection” хийдэг; “infection” (халдвар) гэдэгтэй андуурч болохгүй.

questions.stem: I gave ___ sugar last month because I wanted to lose weight.
questions.explanation: “give up” хэлц үйл үг нь ямар нэг зуршлаа больж орхих гэсэн утгатай; турахын тулд (“because I wanted to lose weight”) чихэр хэрэглэхээ больсон.

questions.stem: My little sister takes ___ my mother. They have the same eyes and smile.
questions.explanation: “take after” нь эцэг эхтэйгээ төрх, зангаараа адилхан байх гэсэн хэлц үйл үг; “They have the same eyes and smile” гэсэн нь үүнийг баталж байна.

questions.stem: We need a ___ of eggs and a ___ of bread.
questions.explanation: Өндгийг хайрцгаар (“a box of eggs”), талхыг бүхэл талхаар (“a loaf of bread”) тоолдог тул “box / loaf” гэж нөхнө.

questions.stem: Eating too much fast food can lead to serious health ___.
questions.explanation: “lead to serious health” гэсэн хэллэгт эрүүл мэндийн асуудал гэсэн хоршоо “health problems” тохирно; “products”, “projects” нь утга зохицохгүй.

questions.stem: If you feel sick for more than three days, you should ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation: Гурваас дээш хоног өвдвөл (“If you feel sick for more than three days”) эмчид үзүүлэх хэрэгтэй бөгөөд үүнийг англиар “see a doctor” гэдэг; “meet a doctor” нь танилцах, уулзах гэсэн утгатай.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct word to complete the conversations. /3 x 2 = 6 points/

questions.stem:
Nurse: How are you feeling today?
Patient: Much better, thanks. The pain has almost gone, and I feel so ___.
questions.explanation: “The pain has almost gone” (өвдөлт бараг арилсан) тул өвчтөний санаа нь амарсан буюу “relieved” (тайвширсан) мэдрэмжтэй байна; “worse”, “terrified” нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem:
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
Customer: Not yet. Could I see the ___, please?
questions.explanation: Зөөгч “Are you ready to order?” гэхэд захиалга өгөхөөс өмнө хоолны цэс буюу “menu” хүссэн; “bill” нь хоол идсэний дараа авдаг төлбөрийн тооцоо.

questions.stem:
Reporter: Thousands of people have no food after three years without a good harvest.
Aid worker: Yes, and the ___ is getting worse every month.
questions.explanation: “Thousands of people have no food” (мянга мянган хүн хоол хүнсгүй) гэсэн нь өлсгөлөн буюу “famine”; “three years without a good harvest” нь түүний шалтгаан.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct prefix to build the antonym of the adjectives. /2 x 2 = 4 points/

questions.explanation: “healthy” (эрүүл) гэдгийн эсрэг утгатай үг нь “un-” угтвартай “unhealthy” (эрүүл бус, эрүүл мэндэд хортой).
“l” үсгээр эхэлсэн “logical” (логиктой) үгэнд “il-” угтвар залгаж “illogical” (логикгүй) гэсэн эсрэг утгатай үг үүсгэнэ.

tasks.title: Conversation 1
tasks.instructions: Read the conversations and choose the best answers for them. There are 2 blanks in the conversation (28-29). Fill in the blanks from the given options. /5 x 2 = 10 points/
tasks.text:
Doctor: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
Gerel: I've had a sore throat and a high temperature since Monday.
Doctor: I see. 28. _________
Gerel: Yes, I took some paracetamol last night, but it didn't help much.
Doctor: Let me have a look... Your throat is very red. I'll give you some antibiotics. Take one tablet three times a day after meals.
Gerel: Can I go to school tomorrow?
Doctor: 29. _________ Stay at home and drink plenty of warm water.
Gerel: OK. Thank you, doctor.

questions.explanation: Гэрэл “Yes, I took some paracetamol last night” гэж хариулсан тул эмч ямар нэг эм уусан эсэхийг асуусан: “Have you taken any medicine?”

options.B: I'd rather you didn't, for at least three days.

questions.explanation: Эмч “Stay at home and drink plenty of warm water” гэж нэмж хэлсэн тул сургуульд явахгүй байхыг эелдгээр зөвлөсөн “I'd rather you didn't, for at least three days.” хариулт тохирно.

questions.stem: Where is the conversation taking place?
questions.explanation: “What seems to be the problem?”, “I'll give you some antibiotics” гэсэн эмч, өвчтөний яриа “At a doctor's surgery” буюу эмчийн үзлэгийн өрөөнд болж байна.

tasks.title: Conversation 2
tasks.text:
Grandma: Look what I found in the cupboard: your father's first pair of shoes!
Saran: They're so tiny! Did Dad really wear these?
Grandma: He did. He took his first steps in them, right here in this kitchen. It feels like yesterday.
Saran: Can I take a photo and send it to him?
Grandma: Of course. He'll laugh. I'm going to keep them forever.

questions.stem: Grandma feels ___ when she finds the shoes.
questions.explanation: Эмээ “It feels like yesterday” гэж хүүгийнхээ анхны алхмыг дурсаж, “I'm going to keep them forever” гэсэн нь “sentimental” (дурсамжинд автсан) мэдрэмжийг харуулна.

questions.stem: Saran is ___ by how small the shoes are.
questions.explanation: Саран “They're so tiny! Did Dad really wear these?” гэж гайхсан тул гутал ийм жижиг байгаад “surprised” (гайхсан) байна.

tasks.title: Passage 1
tasks.instructions: Read the passage and choose the correct answers. /4 x 2 = 8 points/
tasks.text:
Most teenagers need between eight and ten hours of sleep every night, but research shows that many get far less. There are several reasons for this. Homework and after-school activities take up a lot of time, and many young people use their phones in bed late at night.

Scientists have also discovered that teenagers' body clocks are different from those of children and adults. During the teenage years, the body starts producing the sleep hormone melatonin later in the evening. As a result, teenagers often do not feel tired until eleven o'clock or later, but **they** still have to get up early for school.

Lack of sleep can cause serious problems. Tired students find it harder to concentrate and remember information, and they are more likely to feel stressed or have accidents. For this reason, some schools in the United States have started classes later in the morning. The results have been <u>encouraging</u>: students' grades and attendance have improved.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: It is about how adults sleep.
options.B: It is about how phones damage teenagers' eyes.
options.C: It is about schools in the United States.
options.D: It is about why teenagers often lack sleep and what effects this has.

questions.explanation: Эх өсвөр насныхан яагаад бага унтдаг (гэрийн даалгавар, утас, биеийн цаг) болон “Lack of sleep can cause serious problems” гэж нойр дутагдлын үр дагаврыг бүхэлд нь өгүүлнэ.

questions.stem: Teenagers often don't feel tired until late because ___
questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд “the body starts producing the sleep hormone melatonin later in the evening” гэсэн тул өсвөр насныхан орой оройтож байж л ядарч эхэлдэг.

questions.stem: The pronoun "they" in bold in paragraph 2 refers to ___.
questions.explanation: “teenagers often do not feel tired until eleven o'clock or later, but they still have to get up early for school” өгүүлбэрт “they” нь “teenagers” буюу өсвөр насныхныг заана.

questions.stem: The word "encouraging" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.explanation: “The results have been encouraging: students' grades and attendance have improved” гэсэн тул “encouraging” нь урам өгөхүйц, сайн буюу “positive” гэсэн утгатай.

tasks.title: Passage 2
tasks.instructions: Read the text and choose the correct answers. There are 3 blanks in the text (37-39). Fill in the blanks from the given options. /4 x 2 = 8 points/
tasks.text:
Hi Jessica,

How are you? I'm sorry I missed your call yesterday. I 37. _________ dinner with my family at my aunt's house, and my phone was in my bag.

Guess what? I've decided to become a vegetarian! I watched a documentary about farming last month, and since then I 38. _________ any meat. It's not as difficult as I expected. My mum cooks delicious vegetable soup, and I've learned to make a great bean curry.

My little brother says I'm crazy. He can't imagine a day without buuz! But my dad has started eating less meat too, because his doctor told him to.

Are you still coming to visit in June? 39. _________ you come, I'll cook you my bean curry!

Love,
Oyunaa

questions.explanation: “I'm sorry I missed your call yesterday” гэсэн тул утас дуугарах үед гэр бүлийнхэнтэйгээ оройн хоол идэж байсан үргэлжилсэн үйлийг өнгөрсөн үргэлжилсэн цаг “was having” илэрхийлнэ.
“since then” (түүнээс хойш) нь өнгөрсөнд эхэлж одоо хүртэл үргэлжилж буй байдлыг заах тул одоо төгссөн цагийн үгүйсгэл “haven't eaten” орно.
“you come” гэсэн нөхцөлөөс “I'll cook you my bean curry” гэсэн үр дүн гарах тул 1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэрийн “If”; “Unless” нь “if … not” гэсэн эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: The main news in Oyunaa's email is that ___.

options.E: she is visiting Jessica in June

questions.explanation: Имэйлийн гол мэдээ нь “I've decided to become a vegetarian!” буюу Оюунаа мах идэхээ больсон явдал; дүү, аавынх нь тухай хэсэг нь нэмэлт дэлгэрэнгүй.

tasks.instructions: Read the questions (a-e) and complete them with the appropriate words (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “your father” 3-р биеийн ганц тоо бөгөөд байнгын ажлын тухай одоо энгийн цагаар асууж байгаа тул “does”; “work” үндсэн хэлбэрээрээ үлдэнэ.

items.label: b
items.text: Why ___ you at the meeting yesterday?
items.explanation: “Why … at the meeting yesterday?” гэж өчигдөр хуралд ирээгүйн шалтгааныг асууж байгаа тул “you” өгүүлэгдэхүүнд тохирох “be” үйл үгийн өнгөрсөн цагийн үгүйсгэл “weren't” орно.

items.label: c
items.text: How long ___ he been a teacher?
items.explanation: “been” III хэлбэр байгаа тул одоо төгссөн цаг бүтээх “has” хэрэгтэй: “How long has he been a teacher?” нь хэдэн жил багшилж байгааг асууна.

items.label: d
items.text: Which bus ___ you take to school every day?
items.explanation: “every day” байнгын үйлийг заадаг тул одоо энгийн цаг; “you” өгүүлэгдэхүүнтэй туслах үйл үг “do” орно: “Which bus do you take …?”

items.label: e
items.text: What ___ you do if you saw a bear in the forest?
items.explanation: “if you saw a bear in the forest” нь бодит бус таамаг тул асуулт 2-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэрийн гол хэсэг шиг “would” авна.

tasks.instructions: Read the incomplete sentences (a-e) and fill in the gaps with the appropriate words (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “do someone a favour” (хэн нэгэнд тус болох) нь тогтсон хоршоо тул “Could you … me a favour?” гэсэн зайд “do” орно; “make a favour” гэж хэлдэггүй.

items.label: b
items.text: I need to ___ a phone call to my mother.
items.explanation: Утсаар ярихыг “make a phone call” гэж “make” үйл үгтэй хэлдэг тогтсон хоршоо; “do a call” гэж хэлдэггүй.

items.label: c
items.text: Can you ___ me some advice about which phone to buy?
items.explanation: Зөвлөгөө өгөхийг “give advice” гэдэг тул “Can you … me some advice” гэсэн хүсэлтэд “give” орно; “make advice” гэж хэлдэггүй.

items.label: d
items.explanation: Анхаарал хандуулахыг “pay attention to” гэж “pay” үйл үгтэй хэлдэг тогтсон хоршоо: “… attention to the teacher” нь багшдаа анхаарлаа хандуул гэсэн утгатай.

items.label: e
items.text: Try to ___ calm during the exam.
items.explanation: “keep” + тэмдэг нэр нь тухайн байдалдаа хэвээр байх гэсэн утгатай тул “keep calm” (тайван байх); “Try to … calm during the exam” гэдэгт “make”, “do” тохирохгүй.

tasks.instructions: Match the beginnings of the sentences (a-e) with the appropriate endings (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “You should drink more water” гэсэн зөвлөгөөг ямар зорилгоор хэрэгжүүлэхийг “… if you want to have healthy skin.” хэсэг тайлбарлана: арьсаа эрүүл байлгахыг хүсвэл.

items.label: b
items.text: I didn't eat breakfast this morning, …
items.explanation: Өглөө хоол идээгүйн үр дагавар нь одоо өлсөж байгаа явдал тул “so” (тиймээс) холбоостой “… so I'm really hungry now.” тохирно.

items.label: c
items.text: The restaurant where we had lunch …
items.explanation: “The restaurant where we had lunch” бол тодотгол өгүүлбэртэй өгүүлэгдэхүүн бөгөөд үйл үг шаардлагатай тул үйлдэгдэх хэвийн “… is owned by my uncle.” орно.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Although she was ill” (өвчтэй байсан ч) гэсэн эсрэгцүүлэлтэй хэсгийн дараа гэнэтийн үр дүн “… she went to work.” ирнэ; “because she was ill” гэвэл утгагүй болно.

items.label: e
items.explanation: “I had never tried sushi” (өнгөрсөн төгссөн цаг) нь Японд очих хүртэлх хугацааг хэлж байгаа тул “… until I went to Japan.” (Япон явах хүртлээ) тохирно.

choices.text: … if you want to have healthy skin.

tasks.instructions: Match the family words (a-e) with their meanings (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “niece” нь ах эгч, дүүгийнхээ охин (ач, зээ охин) тул “… is the daughter of your brother or sister.”; хүү бол “nephew”.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “grandparents” (өвөө эмээ) нь аав, ээжийн чинь эцэг эх бөгөөд олон тоо учраас “are” үйл үгтэй “… are the parents of your mother or father.” тохирно.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “cousin” (үеэл) нь авга, нагац ах эгчийн хүүхэд: “… is the child of your aunt or uncle.”

items.label: d
items.explanation: “stepfather” (хойт эцэг) нь ээжтэй чинь гэрлэсэн боловч төрсөн аав чинь биш эр хүн: “… is the man who is married to your mother but is not your father.”

items.label: e
items.explanation: “mother-in-law” (хадам ээж) нь нөхөр эсвэл эхнэрийн ээж: “… is the mother of your husband or wife.”

choices.text: … is the mother of your husband or wife.

tasks.title: Listening
tasks.instructions: You are going to listen to a woman interviewing a student about eating habits. Read each question and choose the correct answer. You have 1 minute and 30 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen to the passage twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
tasks.audioScript:
Woman: Hello. I'm from the health centre, and we're doing a survey about students' eating habits. Can I ask you some questions?
Boy: Sure.
Woman: What's your name?
Boy: David Harper. That's H-A-R-P-E-R.
Woman: Thank you, David. Do you usually eat breakfast?
Boy: Not really. I used to have breakfast every day, but now I get up late, so I usually just have a glass of milk.
Woman: And what about lunch?
Boy: I eat in the school canteen. The food is OK, but I'd like more salads.
Woman: How often do you eat fast food?
Boy: About twice a month, usually after football matches with my team. Last year it was every weekend, but my coach told us it's bad for our fitness.
Woman: Do you cook?
Boy: Yes, I cook dinner for my family on Fridays. My speciality is fried rice!
Woman: That's great. One last question: what are you doing after this?
Boy: I'm going to the supermarket. I need to buy vegetables for tonight's dinner.

questions.stem: Why is the woman asking David questions?

options.C: She works in the school canteen.
options.D: She is doing a survey about students' eating habits.

questions.explanation: Эмэгтэй “we're doing a survey about students' eating habits” гэж хэлсэн тул тэр эрүүл мэндийн төвөөс сурагчдын хооллолтын судалгаа хийж байна.

questions.stem: What is the student's name?
questions.explanation: Хүү “David Harper. That's H-A-R-P-E-R.” гэж үсэглэсэн тул “David HARPER”; “HARPPER”, “HARPUR” зэрэгт үсэг илүүдсэн буюу солигдсон.

questions.stem: Last year David ate fast food ___.
questions.explanation: Дэвид “Last year it was every weekend” гэсэн; одоо хурдан хоолыг сард хоёр удаа л иддэг болсон.

questions.stem: Why does David eat less fast food now?

options.A: His coach said it was bad for fitness.
options.D: He doesn't like it any more.
options.E: The school canteen stopped selling it.

questions.explanation: Дэвид “my coach told us it's bad for our fitness” гэж хурдан хоол багасгасан шалтгаанаа хэлсэн; үнэ эсвэл амт нь шалтгаан биш.

questions.stem: What is David going to do after the interview?
questions.explanation: Төгсгөлд Дэвид “I'm going to the supermarket. I need to buy vegetables for tonight's dinner.” гэж хэлсэн тул ярилцлагын дараа супермаркет руу явна.

questions.stem: David does all of the following EXCEPT ___.
questions.explanation: Дэвид “I used to have breakfast every day, but now I get up late” гэсэн тул одоо өглөөний хоол иддэггүй, ихэвчлэн ганц аяга сүү уудаг.
